definitions.explanation: A type of fungus that grows in damp conditions, appearing as fuzzy patches on food, walls, or other surfaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I remove the mold in the bathroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Mold tends to grow during the rainy season.

notes:
カビ is the fungus that appears as fuzzy patches on damp food, walls, and fabric. Normally written in katakana; the kanji {黴|かび} exists but is rare.

VERB PATTERNS:
- カビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: mould grows (the everyday phrase)
- カビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: mould develops (more formal, used in notices)
- カビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove mould

COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧カビ, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧カビ: black mould, blue mould
- カビ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧: musty, smelling of mould
- カビ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{剤|ざい}→剤：noentry⟧: mould remover (a supermarket staple)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's summer is humid, and the ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) in particular makes mould a routine household worry. Airing rooms, running ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧ fans in the ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧, and using moisture absorbers are ordinary parts of the domestic calendar rather than emergency measures.
